title: TaskPass
description: A pass of a task through a node of its scenario: one per entry into the node. The current pass has no fields of closing.

round.description: Number of the pass of the node in the task, from 1.

entered.description: Time the task entered the node in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.

outcome.description: How the pass was closed: exit — by an exit, skip — the stage was skipped.

exit.title: TaskPassExit
exit.description: The exit of a pass closed by an exit.

kind.description: Kind of the exit: artifact — an artifact of the task, result — the result of an event, negative — a negative result with where it was looked for.

artifact.description: Name of the artifact of an exit of kind artifact.

to.description: The node taken from the node, or finish for the end of the scenario.

reason.description: Why the transition was taken, at a fork; why the stage was skipped, for a skip.

source.description: Who closed the pass: operator or agent.

closed.description: Time the pass was closed in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.

steps.description: Steps of the pass in the order added.
